correctness.rationale: The finite nonperiodic n×n knight attack graph has row-column squares and |Δrow|,|Δcol|=(1,2); Ind consists of all nonattacking sets, not just maximal placements. At n<=2 no edges, and at n=3 the center is isolated, so all these complexes are contractible. Independently regenerated both exhaustive face sets for n=4,5 (1,365 and 55,213 augmented faces), the source-specified maximal-toggle sequential Morse matchings (680 and 27,605 pairs), and all 5,788/353,749 Hasse cover orientations; both are acyclic. Removing the augmented empty-face pair leaves a single 0-cell and respectively five/three critical 3-cells, proving the integral S3 wedges. Signed fixed-face Lefschetz sums for all 8 geometric square symmetries independently yield characters (5,-1,1,-1,3,3,-1,-1) and (3,1,-1,1,-1,-1,-1,-1); direct inner products give A1+2B1+E and A2+E. The unverified larger boards and equivariant homotopy type are not inferred.
